description: Unifies NSE's index data with the ETFs and index funds that track them — a join neither source site offers.

tools.name: index_constituents
tools.description: Constituent list (company, industry, symbol, ISIN) for a given index — no per-constituent weight field. Required: slug.

params.name: slug
params.description: Index slug as used in the constituent CSV filename, e.g. nifty50

tools.name: index_live
tools.description: Live snapshot of every published NSE index (level, %chg, OHLC, 52w hi/lo). Sourced from nseindia.com directly — niftyindices.com's own live-blob feed (iislliveblob.niftyindices.com) was found to serve a stale, frozen snapshot months out of date; nseindia.com's allIndices endpoint reflects the actual last trading session. Returns array of IndexLiveQuote.
